after: Worn by the commanders of Dol Guldur, this iron disc offers a shroud of shadow to those who move in the gloom. It grants a mastery over the unseen, ensuring that the shadows obey the command of the one who holds it.
A sense of grave responsibility settles upon the shoulders of the one who drapes this crimson wool. It carries the dignity of Gondor, shielding the body from unseen pressures of the air.

The one who drapes this fabric over their shoulders finds their presence fading into the shadows of the woods. It grants a haunting stillness to the spirit, making the mind sharp and the movements nearly impossible to track.

The polished steel bears the marks of long patrols and the dust of the White City. A clear sense of resolve settles over the head, shielding the mind from external whispers. It is a stout piece of gear, forged for those who stand firm against the tide.

Defended the white walls of Minas Tirith against the shadows of the East. This leather and plate construction allows for quick movement while offering a sturdy bulwark against the foe. A swiftness of spirit accompanies the one who dons it.
A soldier's blade, tempered to withstand the rigors of the White City's defense. It bites deep into whatever it strikes, carrying a biting chill that lingers in the air after a blow.
Gondorian smiths forged this plate to withstand the darkest tides of the East. It stands as a pinnacle of craft, offering a sanctuary of iron that wards off even the most potent of sorceries.
A disciplined posture follows the weight of this steel. The polished plates offer a sturdy defense against the press of battle, while a restless energy quickens the pulse of the one who carries it.
This suit has defended many a traveler from the bite of iron and tooth. The plates sit well upon the frame, offering reliable protection without hindering the stride.
Deep gashes open with ease, leaving wounds that refuse to knit. This matte blade offers a cruel efficiency in the heat of the fray, designed for the grim work of the militia.
Deep gouges across the iron plates tell of many blows parried in the heat of fray. It offers a grim protection against the crushing weight of a mace or the bite of a blade.
This pitted iron helm has weathered the brutal meat-grinder of Mordor. It offers a grim shield against the crude strikes of enemies while allowing the eyes to pierce the deepest gloom.

The one who binds this leather to their waist finds their spirit fortified against the shadows. It grants a sharp clarity of mind and a mastery over the hidden mechanisms of the world. Even in the deepest pits of Dol Guldur, it offers a resilience that mends the body's wear.
Wounds from this jagged bone splinter deep and fester with a lingering venom. The oily residue leaves a staining grime upon the hands of the one who wields it.

This garment has served many a scholar in their pursuit of the arcane. The weave offers a subtle protection against caustic bites while aiding the caster in weaving charms or weaving mists of confusion.
The jagged plates deflect the bite of steel and the crush of stone alike. This blackened iron provides a grim defense against the most common of blades.
Layers of iron plates are bound by thick, oil-slicked leather. While the shield is cumbersome to hold, it offers a stubborn defense against the biting chill and sudden strikes of the wasteland.

Numenorean assassins favored this charcoal leather for its ability to swallow the light. It binds to the limbs with a numbing cold, granting the one who carries it a ghost-like grace within the deepest shadows.
This broad plate has held firm against the brunt of many a siege. It offers a dependable barrier against the biting elements and the heat of the fray.
This blade has harvested many lives and leaves a jarring ring in the air when it strikes. Its notched edge bites deep, leaving the victim dazed and reeling.
The curve of the blade holds a lingering, sickly chill that numbs the hand. Those struck by its edge find the world blurring into a gray haze of shadow.
A craftsman of the wastes shaped this shaft to carry a searing heat. The head bites into the air with a crackle of flame, leaving a trail of scorched earth in its wake.
Heat radiates from the blackened steel, searing the air with every swing. This formidable tool of the deep dark strikes with a crushing force that stills the voices of the living.
Every step falls into a ghostly silence against the frost. The thick lining keeps the biting chill at bay while the mind remains calm in the face of terror.
